# MF BUILDING SA

> MF BUILDING SA is a general building contractor and waterproofing specialist based in Geneva, Switzerland. The company has 17 years of experience and serves the cantons of Geneva and Vaud, working with private homeowners, property management companies (régies), condominium associations (syndics de copropriété) and architects. Free on-site diagnosis and quote within 48 hours, with a written guarantee on completed work.

## Company

- Legal name: MF BUILDING SA
- Legal form: Société anonyme (Swiss corporation), share capital CHF 100'000
- Company ID (UID/IDE): CHE-459.578.054, registered with the Geneva Commercial Registry
- Address: Rue Voltaire 30, 1201 Genève, Switzerland
- Phone: +41 77 910 18 15
- Email: contact@mfbuilding.ch
- Service area: Canton de Genève, Canton de Vaud

## Services (French)

- [Étanchéité de toiture](https://mfbuilding.ch/etancheite-toiture.html): Flat roof waterproofing — membranes, resin, infiltration repair.
- [Étanchéité de terrasse et balcon](https://mfbuilding.ch/etancheite-terrasse.html): Terrace and balcony waterproofing, resin, tiles on pedestals.
- [Étanchéité de sous-sol et cuvelage](https://mfbuilding.ch/etancheite-sous-sol.html): Basement waterproofing and tanking for damp cellars and buried walls.
- [Recherche de fuite](https://mfbuilding.ch/recherche-de-fuite.html): Leak and water infiltration detection and repair.
- [Aménagement extérieur](https://mfbuilding.ch/amenagement-exterieur.html): Wooden decks, paving on pedestals, garden landscaping.
- [Véranda & pergola](https://mfbuilding.ch/veranda-pergola.html): Design, fabrication and installation of verandas and pergolas.
- [Rénovation & entreprise générale](https://mfbuilding.ch/renovation-entreprise-generale.html): General contracting for apartment and house renovation, structural and finishing work.
